=== about ===
bytes=   27974
 
 About us 
 
--
 
 Govt. College, Makdone, was established in the year 2015 (academic session 2015-16) by the Department of Higher Education, Govt. of Madhya Pradesh. Govt. College Makdone is affiliated to Vikram University, Ujjain. The college is presently functioning in the building of Govt. Ravindra Higher Secondary School Makdone. The building of the college is under construction about 60% of the work has been done, and the college will very soon shift to its own building. 

 
The college has three faculties: arts (including economics, political science, sociology, and history), science (including Botany, Zoology, Math’s, Physics, Chemistry, and Computer Science), and Commerce. The college has very experienced and well-qualified faculties most of the faculties are PhD, UGC-NET, AND MP-SET qualified. 
 

=== vision ===
bytes=   27950
 
 Vision-Mission 
 
--
 
 Vision Statement- Government College Makdone Ujjain aspires to be a beacon of knowledge and innovation, nurturing leaders who excel in their chosen fields while embodying integrity Inclusivity and social responsibility. We envision a vibrant learning community where students cultivate a lifelong passion for learning, embrace diversity, and contribute meaningfully to society. 

 Mission Statement- Our mission at Government College Makdone Ujjain is to provide accessible, quality higher education that empowers individuals to realize their full potential and become agents of positive change in their communities and beyond. We are committed to fostering a dynamic learning environment that fosters critical thinking, creativity, and ethical leadership.

 To formulate the college as one of the best place in the region to attain intellectual skills and acquire an affirmative mindset to thrive in an increasingly internationalized and competitive job market simultaneously acting as responsible citizens of the global community by the inculcation of value-oriented education.

WITH RECURSIVE chain(id, root_id, depth, path) AS (
  SELECT id, id, 0, name FROM career_nodes
  UNION ALL
  SELECT p.id, chain.root_id, chain.depth+1, p.name || ' > ' || chain.path
  FROM career_nodes p JOIN chain ON p.id=(SELECT parent_id FROM career_nodes WHERE id=chain.id)
  WHERE chain.depth < 12
)
SELECT root_id AS id,
       (SELECT slug FROM career_nodes WHERE id=root_id) AS slug,
       path AS breadcrumb
FROM chain

  AND depth=(SELECT max(c2.depth) FROM chain c2 WHERE c2.root_id=chain.root_id);
